name: Gdn2Bwd

q.description: 查询张量, shape (B, T, H, K); bfloat16/float16

k.description: 键张量, shape (B, T, H, K); 与 q 同 dtype

v.description: 值张量, shape (B, T, H, V); bfloat16/float16

g.description: log 域衰减门控 (恒 ≤ 0), shape (B, T, H, K); float32

b.description: 擦除门控 (sigmoid 域, (0,1)), shape (B, T, H, K); 与 q 同 dtype

w.description: 写入门控 (sigmoid 域, (0,1)), shape (B, T, H, V); 与 v 同 dtype

initial_state.description: 初始状态, shape (N, H, K, V) float32; shape[0]==0 表示无初始状态

do.description: 输出梯度, shape (B, T, H, V); 与 v 同 dtype

dht.description: 末状态梯度, shape (N, H, K, V) float32; shape[0]==0 表示无

scale.description: q 缩放因子, float 标量

use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel.description: 是否在 kernel 内对 q/k 做 L2 归一化, int 0/1

cu_seqlens.description: varlen 前缀和, int 列表 (如 [0,6,13,26]); 缺省表示等长 (B,T) 布局

dq.description: q 梯度, 同 q 形状与 dtype

dk.description: k 梯度, 同 k 形状与 dtype

dv.description: v 梯度, 同 v 形状与 dtype

dg.description: g 梯度, 同 g 形状与 dtype (float32)

db.description: b 梯度, 同 b 形状与 dtype

dw.description: w 梯度, 同 w 形状与 dtype

dh0.description: 初始状态梯度, shape (N, H, K, V) float32

reference:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F


def _segment_bwd(qn, kn, vf, gf, bf, wf, dof,
                 S_dec_stack, v_new_stack, s, e, dS0, scale):
    dq = torch.zeros_like(qn)
    dk = torch.zeros_like(kn)
    dv = torch.zeros_like(vf)
    dg = torch.zeros_like(gf)
    db = torch.zeros_like(bf)
    dw = torch.zeros_like(wf)
    dS = dS0
    for t in range(e - 1, s - 1, -1):
        S_dec = S_dec_stack[t]
        v_new = v_new_stack[t]
        S_t = S_dec + kn[:, t - s].unsqueeze(-1) * v_new.unsqueeze(-2)
        dq[:, t - s] = scale * (S_t * dof[:, t - s].unsqueeze(-2)).sum(-1)
        dS = dS + (scale * qn[:, t - s]).unsqueeze(-1) * dof[:, t - s].unsqueeze(-2)
        dk_t = (dS * v_new.unsqueeze(-2)).sum(-1)
        dv_new = (dS * kn[:, t - s].unsqueeze(-1)).sum(-2)
        dw[:, t - s] = dv_new * vf[:, t - s]
        dv[:, t - s] = dv_new * wf[:, t - s]
        derase = -dv_new
        dbk = (S_dec * derase.unsqueeze(-2)).sum(-1)
        dS_dec = dS + (bf[:, t - s] * kn[:, t - s]).unsqueeze(-1) * derase.unsqueeze(-2)
        db[:, t - s] = dbk * kn[:, t - s]
        dk_t = dk_t + dbk * bf[:, t - s]
        dg[:, t - s] = (dS_dec * S_dec).sum(-1)
        dS = dS_dec * gf[:, t - s].unsqueeze(-1).exp()
        dk[:, t - s] = dk_t
    return dq, dk, dv, dg, db, dw, dS


def run(q, k, v, g, b, w, initial_state, do, dht,
        scale, use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel, cu_seqlens=None):
    B, T, H, K = q.shape
    V = v.shape[-1]

    qf, kf, vf = q.float(), k.float(), v.float()
    gf, bf, wf = g.float(), b.float(), w.float()
    dof = do.float()

    if use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel:
        q_rstd = torch.rsqrt((qf * qf).sum(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
        k_rstd = torch.rsqrt((kf * kf).sum(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
        qn = qf * q_rstd
        kn = kf * k_rstd
    else:
        qn, kn = qf, kf
        q_rstd = k_rstd = None

    has_init = initial_state is not None and initial_state.shape[0] > 0
    has_dht = dht is not None and dht.shape[0] > 0

    S_dec_all = []
    v_new_all = []
    if cu_seqlens is not None and len(cu_seqlens) > 0:
        N = len(cu_seqlens) - 1
        for n in range(N):
            s, e = int(cu_seqlens[n]), int(cu_seqlens[n + 1])
            S = qf.new_zeros(1, H, K, V)
            if has_init:
                S = S + initial_state[n:n + 1].float()
            for t in range(s, e):
                S_dec = S * gf[:, t].unsqueeze(-1).exp()
                erase = ((bf[:, t].unsqueeze(-1) * kn[:, t].unsqueeze(-1)) * S_dec).sum(-2)
                v_new = wf[:, t] * vf[:, t] - erase
                S = S_dec + kn[:, t].unsqueeze(-1) * v_new.unsqueeze(-2)
                S_dec_all.append(S_dec)
                v_new_all.append(v_new)
    else:
        S = qf.new_zeros(B, H, K, V)
        if has_init:
            S = S + initial_state.float()
        for t in range(T):
            S_dec = S * gf[:, t].unsqueeze(-1).exp()
            erase = ((bf[:, t].unsqueeze(-1) * kn[:, t].unsqueeze(-1)) * S_dec).sum(-2)
            v_new = wf[:, t] * vf[:, t] - erase
            S = S_dec + kn[:, t].unsqueeze(-1) * v_new.unsqueeze(-2)
            S_dec_all.append(S_dec)
            v_new_all.append(v_new)

    S_dec_stack = torch.stack(S_dec_all, dim=0)
    v_new_stack = torch.stack(v_new_all, dim=0)

    dq = torch.zeros_like(qf)
    dk = torch.zeros_like(kf)
    dv = torch.zeros_like(vf)
    dg = torch.zeros_like(gf)
    db = torch.zeros_like(bf)
    dw = torch.zeros_like(wf)

    if cu_seqlens is not None and len(cu_seqlens) > 0:
        N = len(cu_seqlens) - 1
        dh0 = torch.zeros(N, H, K, V, dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device)
        for n in range(N):
            s, e = int(cu_seqlens[n]), int(cu_seqlens[n + 1])
            dS0 = dht[n:n + 1].float() if has_dht else torch.zeros(1, H, K, V, device=q.device)
            r = _segment_bwd(
                qn[:, s:e], kn[:, s:e], vf[:, s:e],
                gf[:, s:e], bf[:, s:e], wf[:, s:e],
                dof[:, s:e], S_dec_stack, v_new_stack,
                s, e, dS0, scale)
            dq[:, s:e], dk[:, s:e], dv[:, s:e] = r[0], r[1], r[2]
            dg[:, s:e], db[:, s:e], dw[:, s:e] = r[3], r[4], r[5]
            dh0[n] = r[6][0]
    else:
        dS0 = dht.float() if has_dht else torch.zeros(B, H, K, V, device=q.device)
        dq, dk, dv, dg, db, dw, dh0 = _segment_bwd(
            qn, kn, vf, gf, bf, wf, dof,
            S_dec_stack, v_new_stack, 0, T, dS0, scale)

    if use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel:
        dq = q_rstd * (dq - qn * (dq * qn).sum(-1, keepdim=True))
        dk = k_rstd * (dk - kn * (dk * kn).sum(-1, keepdim=True))

    return (dq.to(q.dtype), dk.to(k.dtype), dv.to(v.dtype),
            dg.to(g.dtype), db.to(b.dtype), dw.to(w.dtype), dh0)
description:
GDN-2 (Gated DeltaNet 2) chunkwise 反向标杆。对标 fla-org/flash-linear-attention @ main 的 chunk_gdn2_bwd (fla/ops/gdn2/chunk_bwd.py, 由 chunk.py:133 ChunkGDN2Function.backward 调用), 数学定义为前向递推 (fla/ops/gdn2/naive.py) 的精确伴随。
前向 (逐 token, 矩阵状态 S ∈ R^{K×V}, * 为 Hadamard 积):
    S_dec = Diag(exp(g_t)) S_{t-1}
    erase = (b_t * k_t)^T S_dec
    v_new = w_t * v_t - erase
    S_t   = S_dec + k_t ⊗ v_new
    o_t   = (scale * q_t)^T S_t
反向 (对偶递推, dS 从 dht 初始化, 逆序传播; 下标 t 为当前步):
    dqs_t    = S_t @ do_t ; dq_t = scale * dqs_t
    dS      += (scale * q_t) ⊗ do_t
    dk_t     = dS @ v_new_t                      (秩一更新路径)
    dv_new   = dS^T @ k_t
    dw_t     = dv_new * v_t ; dv_t = dv_new * w_t
    derase   = -dv_new
    dbk      = S_dec_t @ derase                  (擦除门读取路径)
    dS_dec   = dS + (b_t * k_t) ⊗ derase
    db_t     = dbk * k_t ; dk_t += dbk * b_t
    dg_t     = sum_V(dS_dec * S_dec_t)           (衰减路径)
    dS      <- dS_dec * exp(g_t)                 (传给上一步)
    dh0      = 递推结束时的 dS
reference 在 run() 内先重算前向递推得到每步 S_dec/v_new 中间量, 再执行反向, solution 同样只接收叶子输入, 需自行重算前向中间量。
输入约束: g 为 log 域衰减, 生成范围 uniform(-1, -0.02) (防止状态指数爆炸); b/w 为 sigmoid 门控, 生成范围 uniform(0, 1); q/k 生成范围 uniform(-0.05, 0.05) —— 真实场景 q/k 为 L2 归一化向量, 此处以小量级保证 delta 规则递推的擦除反馈因子 |1 - b·|k|²| < 1 (大随机值会导致状态指数爆炸); use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel=1 时 reference 在 fp32 下对 q/k 做 L2 归一化 (eps=1e-6) 并将梯度经 rstd 链式回传。
varlen: cu_seqlens 存在时 B 必须为 1, 各 segment 独立反向, dh0 形状 (N, H, K, V)。
